summary: Very short, shaded kerb beside parked cars, with flats 12 m away.
reasons: Apartments 12 m away on this side
Cars park here; heavy tree cover

best_section.where: North kerb at the narrow bend, under the large trees

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 12 m away and a house 17 m away on this side; heavily screened by trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb; a 10 m stretch just fits a light van.
drivers.convention: Parallel parking is signed with no limit, and cars use it.

flags: Homes within about 12-25 m all round
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation; Toowong Creek 397 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the whole stretch, mostly from the north and east.
